name: Corolla
copy: Full petals with deeper, rounded clefts. The closest continuation of the original, with a clearer five-petal silhouette.

name: Field
copy: Five individually shaped petals and a small golden throat. More botanical, with restrained asymmetry.

name: Open
copy: Broad petals meet a larger gold center, with clear channels between them. Airier and more articulate at small sizes.

name: Pressed
copy: Flatter petal crowns and softer corners give the flower a quieter, printed character.
